Marinade For Fish
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:49pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup olive oil
1 garlic clove chopped
1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
1 teaspoon grated lemon juice
Juice of 1 orange
1 tablespoon chopped basil
1 tablespoon chopped parsley
1 tablespoon soy sauce
1/4 cup red onion

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients together and pour over fish. Do not marinate for more than 1 hour, as the fish will begin to cook. 2 Cook fish over charcoal, or on a gas grill, 8 to 10 minutes a side and serve with mango salsa.
